aboutSubheading: Proudly serving Melbourne's inner east for over 15 years
aboutText: SparkPro Electrical has been servicing Richmond and surrounding Melbourne suburbs for over 15 years, delivering reliable electrical solutions for homes and businesses. With a 4.9-star Google rating from 187 reviews, we're trusted by locals for quality workmanship, honest pricing and friendly service. Our licensed A-Grade electricians handle everything from simple power point repairs to complex commercial fit-outs and solar installations.
